# technitium_user (Resource)

Manages a local Technitium user account. In a cluster, users sync from the Primary node to all Secondary nodes automatically.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The account password. The server never returns passwords, so drift in this attribute cannot be detected — the configured value is authoritative.
- `username` (String) The account username.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the account.
- `display_name` (String) Display name for the account.
- `member_of_groups` (Set of String) Groups the user is a member of, e.g. Administrators, DNS Administrators. When unset, group membership is left unmanaged.
- `session_timeout_seconds` (Number) Session timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The username.
